title: Shadow traffic: quality regression + scoring lag alerting rules (beta oncall routing)
author: Allison Grant
release_notes: Adds paging + ticketed alerts for shadow quality regressions and scoring pipeline lag
Routes beta customer regressions to Shadow Traffic oncall (SRE) with product/ML watchers
Links alerts to runbook steps + dashboards for quick triage
description: Context: As we expand shadow traffic dogfood + Dedicated beta, we need a minimal but actionable alert set that (a) catches true quality regressions early and (b) catches pipeline issues (ingestion/scoring lag) that would make the deltas unreliable. This PR adds Alertmanager rules + routing for shadow quality regression detection and scoring pipeline health, with runbook links and sane default thresholds. Scope: (1) New recording rules for shadow quality deltas and confidence gating; (2) Alert rules for quality regression (p0/p1), missing data, and scoring lag/backlog; (3) Alertmanager routing to the Shadow Traffic beta oncall rotation with dedup keys that avoid cardinality blowups; (4) Runbook links and dashboard annotations used in notifications. Key design points: - Regression alerts are gated on minimum sample size + confidence (avoid noisy paging). We only page when both (i) sample count >= threshold and (ii) the 95% CI excludes 0 (or baseline) for the delta; otherwise we open a ticket for investigation. - All alert labels are limited to tenant_tier / deployment_mode / route_group / metric_name / experiment_id (hashed). We explicitly do NOT include customer_id, prompt_id, model_id, or full route paths. - Fail-open principle: these alerts are for visibility only; they do not change routing/rollouts automatically. Follow-up work (separate PR): wire these alerts into Console “Quality deltas” callouts and auto-link the active shadow experiment and rollout timeline entry. Testing: validated rules in staging with replayed shadow events (dogfood tenant) and confirmed page/ticket routing + dedup behavior; verified no high-cardinality label leaks in Alertmanager. Related: ENG-5409, ENG-5415; incident follow-up SUP-28477 (missing deltas were scoring lag). Runbooks: Confluence: Eng Platform Runbooks → Shadow Traffic rollout & rollback (section “Alerts & triage”), and SRE playbook stub added under /runbooks/shadow-traffic-alerts.md.

conversation: Sean Gallagher (review): Can we be explicit about when we page vs ticket? Also please add a 'no data' alert so we can tell the difference between a true zero and the pipeline being broken.

Allison Grant (author): Added gating summary to the alert annotations + PR description. Added ShadowScoringNoData (ticket) and ShadowScoringLagHigh (page) with clear separation. Also added a recording rule for 'shadow_scoring_events_present' to avoid flaky absent() behavior across shards.
Logan Wright (review): Label safety: I’m worried experiment_id might explode. Are we hashing/truncating and do we cap number of concurrent experiments in alerts?

Allison Grant (author): Yes. experiment_id label is now experiment_hash (first 10 chars of SHA256, computed at ingestion) and only attached for paging alerts; ticket alerts are aggregated at route_group + metric_name. Added explicit allowed-labels file + validation script test that fails CI if customer_id/prompt_id/model_id show up.

Selene Huang (review): For quality regressions, can we ensure sample size is large enough to not be purely random noise? Also, rubric metrics have different variance; a fixed N might be too low for some.

Allison Grant (author): Implemented per-metric min_sample thresholds (defaults: format_adherence=2k, refusal_rate=5k, instruction_following=3k) with overrides via config map. This matches Applied ML’s power notes we discussed. Added annotation to page with current N and CI width.
Nadia Rahman (review): Scoring lag alerts should reference both queue backlog and end-to-end freshness; backlog alone doesn’t catch stuck workers when ingestion is fine.

Allison Grant (author): Added end-to-end freshness alert: shadow_scoring_result_age_p95 > 15m for 10m (page) and > 5m for 30m (ticket). Backlog alert kept as early signal with longer for: window. Both link to the runbook.

Sean Gallagher (approval): This is in the right place. Paging thresholds look reasonable for beta. Please make sure PD routing uses the 'shadow-traffic-beta' service (not the generic inference service) so oncall doesn’t get mixed signals.
Allison Grant (author): Updated PD service + added team watchers (Product + Applied ML) as Slack notifications only; pages stay SRE-only. Rerun CI.
Marissa Cole (comment): Thanks—please add the Confluence runbook link in the alert description so we can share screenshots during beta onboarding.
Allison Grant (author): Done (both alert annotations and PD incident body include it).
Sean Gallagher (final approval): LGTM. Merge after CI green.
final_outcome: Merged to main; alerts enabled in staging immediately and behind feature flag in prod for beta tenants only (see alertmanager route matcher shadow_traffic_enabled=true).
